# USAJOBS fixtures

Replayed by `tests/test_usajobs.py` with `JOB_SCOUT_REPLAY_DIR=tests/fixtures/http/usajobs`.
Each file is named `sha1(url)[:16].json` and holds `{"url", "status", "body"}`, like the
parent folder. No file holds a key, an email or a request header (net.py never records
headers), and a test checks this.

## Real recordings (Historic JOA, no key needed) — 2026-10-19

Recorded live with net.py record mode from
`https://data.usajobs.gov/api/historicjoa?USAJOBSControlNumbers=<n>`:

| Control number | Status | What it shows |
|---|---|---|
| 887700000 | 200, `positionOpeningStatus: "Accepting applications"`, close 2026-11-06 | open job |
| 887776000 | 200, `"Applications under review"`, close 2026-10-13 | closed job |
| 887776101 | **204, empty body** | unknown control number |

Tests pin "today" through `usajobs._today`, so they do not go stale when 887700000 closes.

## Synthetic (Search) — not real API output

The Search endpoint needs a per-user key, which this repo does not have, so these five files
were **written by hand** (generated by a one-off script) in the documented response shape:
https://developer.usajobs.gov/api-reference/get-api-search (example "Response JSON", checked
2026-10-19). Their bodies carry `"synthetic": true`. Agencies, titles and control numbers
(900000100–900000103) are made up.

- `Keyword=nurse`, pages 1–3 (`NumberOfPages: "3"`; page 3 exists so a test can prove the
  adapter stops at `MAX_PAGES = 2`), `Keyword=data scientist` page 1, `Keyword=pharmacist`
  page 1 (empty). Items repeat across pages and terms to test de-duplication.
- `UserArea.Details.TeleworkEligible` / `RemoteIndicator` are **not** in the official example;
  their names and boolean type come from open-source client models (see
  `references/ats-notes.md`). They are the least certain part of these fixtures.
- `MinimumRange`/`MaximumRange` are strings, as in the official example. `MajorDuties` appears
  both as a string (official example) and as a list (client models).

When a real key is available, re-record Search with `JOB_SCOUT_RECORD_DIR` and compare the
shape before trusting these.
